question: Annotate LC-MS peaks by matching each query m/z against the provided HMDB database using a mass tolerance of +/-0.01 Da, and report up to 3 candidate metabolites per peak ranked by absolute ppm error.

expected_output.guidelines: Per-peak annotation rows must match the reference in query_mz and hmdb_id (exact) and ppm_error within +/-0.001; candidates per peak must be ranked by ascending absolute ppm_error; column order and extra columns may differ.
